_readme: Ramya's own authoritative professional profile. Ships empty — nothing here is fabricated or seeded. This file is the ONLY source opportunity_scoring.py and resume_tailoring.py may cite as fact. Fill in verified_experience with real, checkable roles/certifications/projects; transferable_experience and knowledge_training may inform framing but are NEVER rendered as hands-on fact in a draft; claims_requiring_verification are never used in any draft until moved to verified_experience by hand.

schema.verified_experience: array of {id, category, claim, employer_or_context, dates, evidence_note} — category is one of: role, certification, project, skill, achievement. This is the only category resume_tailoring.py may present as fact.
schema.transferable_experience: array of {id, category, claim, context, dates, evidence_note} — real experience in an adjacent area that supports but does not prove the specific claim (e.g. 'led risk assessments' as transferable evidence toward 'AI risk governance', not proof of it)
schema.knowledge_training: array of {id, category, claim, source, dates, evidence_note} — training, courses, certifications-in-progress, or studied frameworks; never rendered as implementation experience
schema.claims_requiring_verification: array of {id, category, claim, note} — something that might be true but hasn't been confirmed against a real record; excluded from every draft until moved to verified_experience
